verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 5 remains correct, sound, and complete. The shared generated_at grammar gates both artifact validation and service-order derivation; dispatch consumes only a validated plan and binds the active repository to review_service_queue(plan, repo). That helper exact-matches repository rows before applying a deterministic, non-destructive, total rotation, so it neither crosses repository policy boundaries nor drops admitted work. Malformed timestamps refuse even for empty and singleton queues. The fairness claim is accurately limited to a probabilistic improvement over a permanently closed fixed-order tail, without asserting a bounded deadline. The tests pin exact offsets, rotation shape, reproducibility, totality, repository isolation, malformed-input refusal, the production AST call site and both call arguments, and non-vacuity against representative permissive mutations. I found no correctness, trust-boundary, security, or test-validity issue. Round 4 likewise had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required rubric while approval remains warranted.
